market_name: Will 5 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether 2y/10y Treasury yields are falling in tandem and whether fed funds futures (SOFR strip) confirm a dovish shift; if yields are flat the signal is likely noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move vs. the implied-probability jump; confirm no competing macro headline (CPI, jobs, Fed speak) is driving rates independently.
time_plan.2h: Re-assess whether the move has follow-through or has begun to mean-revert; watch volume on TLT.
time_plan.6h: Check for any scheduled Fed communications or data releases that could override; evaluate whether the rates repricing held.
time_plan.12h: Mark final TLT return vs. prediction; note whether the dovish signal persisted into the next session's rates futures.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 5 Fed cuts in 2026 signals a more dovish rate path than currently priced. Expected lower policy rates pull down the yield curve, raising long-bond prices. TLT is the most direct liquid proxy for a dovish repricing. Magnitude in a 12h window is modest because this single market is a noisy sensor and cut expectations are already heavily priced by the broader rates complex.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm DXY and EURUSD are moving consistently with a dovish US repricing rather than idiosyncratic euro/yen drivers.
time_plan.1h: Check short-end US yield move vs. foreign yields; dollar should weaken only if US rate expectations fell relative to peers.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether move is holding or reversing; watch for any ECB/BOJ headlines that confound.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate dollar trend and whether the rate-cut repricing is still intact.
time_plan.12h: Record final UUP return vs. prediction and whether rate-differential narrative held.

predictions.reasoning: More expected Fed cuts narrow US rate differentials versus other major currencies, which is typically dollar-negative. UUP tracks the broad dollar and would drift lower on a credibly more dovish 2026 path. Confidence is moderate because FX also responds to relative central-bank expectations abroad, so the mapping is weaker than for Treasuries.

evidence_used: Market question references number of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026, a direct monetary-policy expectation gauge
Dovish Fed repricing historically lowers Treasury yields (raises TLT) and weakens the dollar
Fed funds / SOFR futures and the yield curve are the standard transmission channels
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradability threshold is far above any plausible 12h move from this signal, so neither prediction is tradable under the stated rule
Fed cut expectations are already broadly priced across rates markets; incremental info from one Polymarket question is likely small
Direction depends on WHICH way the implied probability moved — a drop in 5-cut odds would invert both calls
The 'military_conflict' topic tag appears mislabeled; question is purely monetary policy

llm_justification.summary: This is a Fed monetary-policy expectation market. If the implied probability of 5 rate cuts in 2026 rises sharply, it signals a more dovish path than priced, which maps to lower Treasury yields (TLT up) and a weaker dollar (UUP down). Both are liquid, direct proxies but the 12h magnitude is small and well below the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is a research-only mapping with moderate confidence.
key_assumptions: A move in this market reflects a genuine shift in dovish Fed expectations rather than thin-market noise
The direction of interest is an INCREASE in 5-cut probability (more dovish)
No overriding macro data/headline dominates rates over the 12h window
failure_modes: The probability move reflects already-public information (post-FOMC, post-CPI) and is fully priced in assets
The signal is noise from a thin prediction market with no real information content
Dollar move fails because foreign central banks are simultaneously dovish, leaving differentials unchanged
Direction is actually a fall in 5-cut odds (hawkish), inverting both predictions
Expected move is far below the 700bps threshold, so neither is actionable
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
